question.text: Study the structure of maltose and mark the incorrect statement.

options.text: Maltose is composed of two <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></math> -D-glucose units
C-1 of one glucose is linked to C-4 of other unit

solution.text: It is a reducing sugar. The free aldehyde group can be produced at C-1 of second glucose in solution and it shows reducing properties.
